title: Chapter 269
text:
Hao Tian was the face of Long Sky, a top tier god. His PK skills were superb, and his level was way above average. With these two advantages, he was the first to enter the stage. His punches and kicks were violent, and he defeated three Protoss players in a row.

The combat power of the Pugilist class was displayed vividly. The audience thought that they would see a fierce battle, but they did not expect it to be a one-sided battle. The whole battle did not even last more than five minutes!

This shock was like a wild horse that had unleashed a wild and unrestrained move, ruthlessly stomping on everyone's hearts.

After being stunned for a few seconds, deafening cheers and applause erupted, reaching the clouds!

"Awesome!" This was the audience.

"God Hao Tian! God Hao Tian! "This was the fanatical audience.

"F * ck Tian Tian, I'm cheering for you!" This was Hao Tian's die-hard fan.

Hao Tian's performance refreshed the audience's understanding of the upper limit of the current level of combat power, and he gained a large number of fans!

Although this was a private bet, the audience's enthusiasm and excitement made people think that this was a professional match.

"I won." Hao Tian's eyes moved slightly. He did not expect to win so easily.

It was as if he had walked a long way and suddenly turned around and realized that the people behind him were all noobs. His combat power had unknowingly exceeded that of a normal professional player.

In the beginning, Hao Tian only saw Han Xiao's' hidden quest 'as a chance to test his luck. After he was lucky enough to win it, he did not treasure it and only saw it as a short-term springboard. Hao Tian's professional instinct was to plan his own development from a long-term perspective. Black Phantom was a Mechanic, and he was a Pugilist, so he felt that he could not follow Han Xiao forever. Just in terms of skills, he had to find a new mentor somewhere else.

However, it was not until now that he realized how much he had gained, and he could not help but value Han Xiao more.

Even at max level, the high EXP reward from Black Phantom's mission is very reasonable, Hao Tian thought to himself.

Black Phantom's mission reward was really rich, so there was no harm in enduring the weird mission. As a professional player, inhuman willpower, endurance, and stamina were basic qualities.

"The Black Phantom line seems to be able to develop for a long time, much longer than I expected."

The agreement was to win three out of five, and Hao Tian would end the bet with a one-versus-three victory. The other Long Sky players were just there to watch, looking at Hao Tian like fanboys. In the Long Sky Club, Hao Tian, who had been in the pro scene for many years, was everyone's idol. He was quiet, focused on techniques, and won many trophies for Long Sky. He was one of the founding members of Long Sky and had already been tied to the name 'Long Sky'.

The Protoss had been thoroughly defeated. All the team members they had invited were dumbfounded.

GG, we're all pro players. Aren't you showing off too much? At least give them some face!

The players already knew how strong Hao Tian was. Not to mention his skills, the biggest problem was his level, attributes, and skills. They immediately thought of how Hao Tian had triggered Black Phantom's hidden storyline, and they could not help but feel envious.

"I wonder what kind of missions he usually does for Black Phantom to level up so quickly."

The Temple of God players were envious and jealous. They also wanted such treatment, but Black Phantom did not give them any face.

"Everyone's levels are not high now, so the gap is huge. When the Pro League starts, everyone's levels will be higher, and he won't be able to beat us as easily as he did today. The gap will shrink sooner or later." A Temple of God player cheered everyone up.

The team members were only pulled over to help, so winning or losing was not important to them. However, Jupiter was so angry that his face turned green. He wanted to smash Jade Green Sky's smug face with his head.

Under the official notarization, the mission item was returned to Sky Territory.

The audience that had left excitedly discussed Hao Tian's outstanding performance.

The conflict between guilds was always a hot topic. Losing the bet was only a temporary loss of face for Guild of God. They were still a powerhouse, so many people in the guild felt it was unfair.

"If our great Li Ge was here, Hao Tian would have been beaten to a pulp."

"Long Sky is just lucky. What's there to be proud of?"

When the dust settled, Han Xiao finally arrived the next day. The people of Sky Territory handed in the mission immediately. Seeing this, Jupiter was filled with regret.

If he had known that Han Xiao would appear today, he would have waited one more day, and everything would have been fine.

Of course, this was only Jupiter's own opinion.

As long as the conflict did not escalate to a battle, Han Xiao would not come out. He had a very high level of patience. Back then, when the nightmare started, he had endured in the Germinal Organization base for half a year before he found the opportunity to escape and turn the situation around.

In fact, Han Xiao had prepared even more dirty tricks. If the two big guilds made a deal in private and did not end up in a conflict … Han Xiao's motto was to do it again if it did not work once. At most, he would drag more guilds into the mess. He was good at fanning the flames, and he could guarantee that the hatred would burn.

If that still did not work, he would simply issue a mission and ask the guilds to book the entire arena. However, that would be too obvious, and Han Technician preferred to play dirty.

"What a loss." Jupiter wanted to cry but had no tears.

This time, a private message notification sounded. He took a look and saw that it was from Li Ge. He quickly picked it up.

"Great Li Ge?"

"Hmm, I saw what you guys did recently. Do you have a recording of Hao Tian's battle?"

"It's all recorded."

"Send it to me."

"Oh, okay."

After receiving the recording, Li Ge said with satisfaction, "With the recording, I can analyze his battle style and prepare for the Pro League. You guys did well."

Hearing this, Jupiter's dejection was swept away, and he pulled himself together.

It did not matter how much they suffered as long as the team had the advantage. Being the team's nanny was one of the responsibilities of the guild.

…

The battle between the guilds showed the effect of the arena. Many people started to have ideas, and gradually, other guilds and players started to book the entire arena to guard the arena or do other activities. The function of the arena gradually came into play. Other than PK, the players in the arena could also participate in other activities, making the arena even livelier.

Other than gameplay, Galaxy also had a social function, and the lively arena was obviously a great place to socialize. Some players would rather spend all their time in the arena twenty-four hours a day in order to "lose their sense of purpose because of the game."

As a place with high exposure, people who wanted to spread their fame had a need for the arena. Guilds would organize small activities to increase their fame, and professional players would come to guard the arena and interact with the normal players. It was like some stadiums that were rented to celebrities to hold concerts. Everyone was getting what they wanted.

According to Han Xiao's experience, not only guilds, but even some companies would book the entire arena to hold small activities. For example, the "XX (Company Name) Cup League" was a commercial competition that was not recognized by the eSports Association. The winner would give a prize to attract participants and promote their fame. Some professional players would even participate in such small competitions for the prize money.

Do not ask how he knew this. In his previous life, there was a time when Han Xiao became extremely rich. He even dared to buy instant noodles from the convenience store downstairs.

Furthermore, the activities held by merchants did not have to be PK competitions. They could be art parties or sports activities.

There had always been an audience for small games in the game, as Galaxy was extremely realistic. Other than not being able to excrete, there was a lot of freedom. The players could use their own imagination and use their superhuman qualities to play other sports, such as superhuman basketball, pugilist soccer, mechanic racing, and so on. Han Xiao had seen all of these in his previous life, and such creative and fun activities were very popular among the casual players.

Galaxy also slowly formed a virtual interactive community because of this. It was very strange and lively.

The current players had only just come into contact with Galaxy, so they had to follow the rules and not do any weird activities. Han Xiao had provided a platform to guide the players to explore the entertainment aspect of the game. There would always be rich people who bought the arena and came up with all kinds of gimmicks.

The arena was like an activity program to attract players. Normal players could watch the activities while fighting each other for free, so it was easy for them to form a habit and tradition. Think about it, if you went for a walk every day, the park you walked in would often hold all kinds of activities. Over time, even if you did not participate, you would gradually become curious and guess what kind of activities you would see next time you walked.

Therefore, when the arena became a common facility, it would increase the sense of belonging of the players to the main city in the long run. After all, interest could be cultivated. In other words, it was the same principle as training. You had to let them get used to it before they would like it and take the initiative in the end …
